g.text: a)将皮带固定到左侧皮带夹上
b)使用弹簧式千分尺检查皮带的张紧度 - 如果是第一次操作，
c)在张紧皮带的同时，用千分尺进行实时测量
d)最大值为 13.5，最小值为 12.5。如果大于 13.5，
则表示张紧过度；如果小于 12.5，则需要进一步张紧。
a) Attach the belt to the left side belt clamp
b) Inspect the tensioning of the belt using the spring loaded micrometer
If it's your 1st time, Ask the mentor how to do so-
c) Live measure with the micrometer as you tension the belt
d) Maxmimum value is 13.5 and minimum value is 12.5
if more than 13.5 it's over tensioned
and if less than 12.5 it needs to be tentioned more.
